description: This file defines types, constants, and functions related to core tools and their organization within the openclaw project, including tool profiles, sections, and groupings.

methods.name: listCoreToolIdsForProfile
methods.description: Returns list of tool IDs allowed for a given profile.

methods.name: resolveCoreToolProfilePolicy
methods.description: Resolves and returns the policy for a given profile string.

methods.name: listCoreToolSections
methods.description: Returns the list of core tool sections with their tools.

methods.name: resolveCoreToolProfiles
methods.description: Returns the profiles associated with a specific tool ID.

methods.name: isKnownCoreToolId
methods.description: Checks if a tool ID is recognized in the core tool definitions.
